name: Anomaly detectors
description: Optional Anomaly context and runner from a pinned detector catalogue. At Methodology it lists the data sources and detectors that fit a case; in Investigation the investigator runs a chosen detector on tables it fetched, through Anomaly's one-shot runner, and the signals become leads for the Investigation gate.
egress_note: None from Spotlight. Spotlight runs only Anomaly's read-only lookup (anomaly.context) and its one-shot runner (anomaly.oneshot); it never runs the data-source adapters under data-skills/, some of which fetch over the network. The lookup reads the checkout offline; methods run locally on read-only copies of case tables, in a child process with no keys in its environment, and Anomaly loads the tables into an in-memory DuckDB and disables external access before any method SQL runs.
risk_note: A method signal is a lead, never a finding or evidence. The installed catalogue is read only when its schema is supported and its catalogue_hash matches its own content; a detector whose implementation hash changed since Methodology approval is refused.
